::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru fabless pioneer whose Pruthvi software-defined radio chips launched in 2015; Pruthvi-3 (28nm FD-SOI) followed in December 2018. Tejas Networks (Tata group) acquired a 64.4% stake in 2022. Clients have included ISRO and BEL; its DLI project is a 5G baseband SoC.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Software-defined radio SoCs for broadcast (ATSC 3.0, 5G broadcast), satellite-terrestrial communications and 5G telecom baseband.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Software-defined radio SoCs for broadcast, satellite and 5G baseband.
- **IP ownership 5/5:** Own Pruthvi SDR chip family, developed in-house since 2015.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Pruthvi chips launched in 2015; Pruthvi-3 on 28nm FD-SOI followed in 2018.
- **Market readiness 4/5:** Clients include ISRO and BEL with Rs 75 crore turnover; the DLI 5G SoC is still in development.
